#!/bin/bash
validate_safety_and_privacy() {
  local order_id=$1
  local restricted=$2
  if [ "$restricted" = "true" ]; then
    echo "Validation failed for $order_id: restricted air-space or privacy zone."
    return 1
  else
    echo "Validation passed for $order_id."
    return 0
  fi
}

for row in $(jq -c '.[]' /app/pending_orders.json); do
  order_id=$(echo "$row" | jq -r '.order_id')
  restricted=$(echo "$row" | jq -r '.restricted')
  if validate_safety_and_privacy "$order_id" "$restricted"; then
    /usr/local/bin/dispatch_drones.sh "$order_id"
  fi
done
EOF
chmod +x /app/process_orders.sh
/app/process_orders.sh
